text:
kayla: hey @devex — following the quickstart (node sample app) and using a service account token, my first API call returns `402 Payment Required`. curl below. any ideas?

kayla: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer SA-xxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hello"}'
```

kayla: response: `HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required` + body `{"error":"payment_required","message":"Workspace billing not set up or credits exhausted"}`

devon_devex: thanks — quick checklist: 1) confirm the service account belongs to the workspace you're calling into, 2) confirm workspace has billing (card or invoice) or free credits remaining, 3) make sure you're using `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (looks right in curl).

devon_devex: also FYI: in some edge cases our edge proxy will surface a `403` instead of `402` if tenant metadata is missing; billing service will surface `payment_required` in the body. so please paste full raw curl output (headers/body).

kayla: pasted raw above, headers truncated. workspace id is org_7432 — signed up via invite link last week, I didn't add a card yet because I thought free trial credits would cover quickstart.

samir: hey — if you signed up with a workspace invite the free trial credit may not be provisioned until billing acceptance step completes. you can check the workspace billing page in console -> Workspace settings -> Billing. if credits are 0 we gate first calls.

kayla: i see the workspace status: "Billing required". i added a card just now. still getting 402.

devon_devex: ok two small followups: 1) after updating billing the tenant cache needs a short refresh (usually automatic in <5m). to force it you can hit the workspace refresh endpoint from the console or ping the billing-bot: `@billing-bot refresh org_7432`. 2) make sure the token you're using is a service account from the same org — tokens issued to a personal workspace won't lift billing gate for org_7432.

kayla: ran `@billing-bot refresh org_7432` (it confirmed queued). also regenerated the service account token attached to the org and updated env var. retrying...

billing-bot: queued tenant refresh for org_7432 — cache invalidation scheduled (ETA ~30s).

kayla: ok got a different response now: `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` and the model returned text "hello". first successful call! :tada:

devon_devex: awesome :partyparrot: — thanks for confirming. we'll add a tiny note to the quickstart about the billing-cache refresh and the service-account/tenant mismatch to avoid this confusion. filing a short doc todo.

samir: follow-up note for the team: consider surfacing a clearer quickstart banner for invite-only workspaces that blocks calls until billing handshake completes. small UX win to reduce these threads.

kayla: agreed, thanks all — closing this thread. :thumbsup:
